packageRules.description: Runtime Python deps stay manual: no PR CI runs pytest.
Docker base-image updates stay manual: the Dockerfile build/hadolint only run on release, not on PRs.

npm updates stay manual by default: vite/svelte and other build-stack deps feed the release-only Docker frontend build (npm ci + npm run build), which is not run on PRs. Lint/format tooling is automerged by the rule below.
Automerge GitHub Actions digest re-pins only. Non-major version bumps stay manual because the release pipeline (docker-image.yml) only runs on release, not on PRs.

Automerge lint / formatter tooling only. These neither feed the frontend build nor ship at runtime, so a bad update's worst case is a failing lint, not broken shipped code. Evaluated last so it wins over the manager rules above (e.g. ruff in requirements-dev.txt, eslint in devDependencies).
